answer_1.quote: Such paraphrases may also be useful for improving the task of machine translation, avoiding the need for parallel MWE corpora.
answer_1.outputs: The paper focuses on generating paraphrases and evaluating idiomaticity in noun compounds, with applications in paraphrase generation and machine translation.

answer_2.quote: We calculated the Euclidean distances between (i) the annotators' vectors and (ii) the cosine similarities between sentence embeddings of each of the possible combinations of the three sentences associated to each NC. Then, we measured the correlations between these values using Spearman ρ.

answer_4.quote: We used Amazon Mechanical Turk to obtain the annotations for English, and a dedicated online platform for the questionnaire in Portuguese, as we could not find a suitable number of annotators for this language in AMT.
answer_4.guideline: We asked participants for: (i) the contribution of the head to the meaning of the NC; (ii) the contribution of the modifier to the meaning of the NC; and (iii) the degree of compositionality of the compound.
